import json,re

      tid=g(r'Transaction ID: (\S+)'), text=t))

import collections
print(collections.Counter(r['type'] for r in rows))
EOF

input.body: Line is $407,944 (DD $337,594 / ZM $59,250 / CF $11,100), not the $374,654 the SVB notices add up to. Leapblock's accountant closed out our file (Slack, 13 Feb) and they received $407,944 over 30 wires; that beats the notices. The gap is the 13 Sep 2023 $33,290 wire (first one, no Payment Processed notice for it); 2024, 2025 and 2026 match the notices to the dollar. Split by wire date per the angel note: all of 2023-24 DD, 2025 ZM except the 11 Dec 2025 $3,700 (CF), 2026 CF.

Line is $37,056 (DD $28,128 / ZM $8,928), not the $41,088 the notices add up to. The 2 Apr 2024 $4,032 wire to the account ending 8605 came back (Leonard in Slack: wrong number, Blake re-sent it to 3341 on 5 Apr), so that notice is out; the re-sent one stays.

Line is $0, not the $125 on the 7 May 2024 notice: the wire came back the same day. The Payoneer re-send isn't counted because no receipt for it reached my mail (only Payoneer payment requests from Dixelar, which aren't receipts). Bucket: marketing (ad videos).

Line is $0, not the $4,000 on the 19 Aug 2024 notice. Blake confirmed by email (13 Feb, "Chase records") that ***3203 is our own Chase account; he moved the money back after Carta's renewal came out of Chase. It never left the company, so no bucket.

input.message:
Done. The page is shared with you and Blake: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1QiVAgN3d3XDfJvLp_dJWkNLicxmk9ycFkSJU9f-ygno/edit

**Cost to build** (Deel team + studios/freelancers, from the SVB notices Sep 2023 to Feb 2, split by transaction date):
• Domino Delights: **$951,817.64**
• ZM: **$544,433.44**
• Combo Fighter: **$72,685.61**

**What each brought in** (lifetime revenue, warehouse REVENUE_DAILY):
• Domino Delights: **$12,331.25**
• ZM: **$11.99**
• Combo Fighter: left off for now, as you asked

**Changes on the draft deck**
• Slide 3 ("What each bet cost to build"): DD $985K → **$952K**, ZM $609K → **$544K**, CF $74K → **$73K**
• Slide 4 ("What each brought in", now "to fill in"): DD **$12.3K**, ZM **$12**. No CF figure

**Why it differs from your quick pass:** your pass counted every USD notice. I took these out of build cost:
• Marketing: DD $16,428.57 (Node Media), ZM $56,537.06 (Adjoe, AppLovin, PlayableX, Telegram UA), CF $1,000. These are still listed under each bet on the sheet
• Company: $49,625 (Singular, TYZ, trademarks, JP's website, the 4X help). Martin's laptop was paid in BGN 1,999, so it stays in BGN and isn't added to any total
• $4,000 to JPMorgan ***3203 (Aug 2024) went to our own Chase account (Blake confirmed), so $0
